name: rpn_tokenize_whitespace_bug
task: tokenize() splits the expression on single space characters only. Consecutive spaces or tabs produce empty-string tokens, which later crash std::stod inside evaluate_rpn() with a std::invalid_argument (e.g. "3   4 +" or a tab-separated expression fails even though it should evaluate normally). Fix tokenize() so that any run of whitespace (spaces, tabs) is treated as a single delimiter and no empty tokens are produced. Do not change the function's signature.
